about_the_game:
💥 Cyberstrike Chronicles

Deliver with style. Move with purpose. Rule the streets of Neon Spires.

Step into the boots of Azure Stormrider, a fearless courier navigating the neon-soaked districts of a futuristic city. With her cybernetic arm and acrobatic skillset, Azure doesn’t just complete deliveries — she makes them look good.

Cyberstrike Chronicles is a fast-paced traversal game built around momentum, fluid movement, and personal expression. Swing, slide, leap, and trick your way through high-speed delivery jobs across dangerous, ever-evolving environments. Every move counts — and the flashier you are, the more you’re rewarded.

🎮 Key Features

  • 🏙️ Master Districts of Neon Spires – Each area brings new challenges, layouts, and secrets to uncover.

  • 🪝Style-Driven Traversal – Use parkour-inspired movement, high-flying swings, and wall slides to dominate the city from the rooftops to the back alleys.

  • 💥 Trick System with Purpose – Chain together stylish moves to earn Trick Points and convert them into bonus rewards.

  • 📦 Dynamic Mission Runs – Complete time-sensitive deliveries while choosing your own path through the environment.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6006, 2.0 GHz or AMD equivalent
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 950 or AMD Radeon RX 470
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-7700, 3.60 GHz or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 6GB or AMD Radeon RX 580 8GB

short_description: Swing through Neon Spires with style as a daring courier, mastering speed, flow, and gravity-defying tricks. Use your cybernetic arm to deliver high-stakes packages in record time across a futuristic city built for momentum and creativity.
supported_languages:
English*, Portuguese - Brazil
*languages with full audio support
